research_stewardship.title: Who has the strongest initial pain and buying reason?
research_stewardship.context: The industrial-support IT profile is a proposed focus, not proven product-market fit.
questions: Who performs triage and patch approval, and who buys the product?
What volume, delay or repeated manual work can they demonstrate?
Which existing tools and policies constrain them?
What measurable outcome would justify adoption or payment?
research_stewardship.closeWith: Recorded customer discovery with permitted evidence, competing-workflow comparison and explicit assumptions; no demand or superiority claim without evidence.
research_stewardship.timing: Before committing a customer pilot or expanding scope.

research_stewardship.title: What real organizational data can we legally access?
research_stewardship.context: Public vulnerability records are real data but do not provide a real customer inventory or policies. Synthetic scenarios stay labelled. Amr reviews advisory-source rights; Shams reviews asset-data access and collection feasibility.
questions: Can Iskraemeco or another partner provide written, scoped access to inventories, configurations or reviewed policies?
What minimization, de-identification, permissions, retention and publication restrictions apply?
What can the prototype, MVP and pilot honestly demonstrate with their available data?
research_stewardship.closeWith: A data-access agreement or recorded refusal/unknown, provenance manifest and stage-specific dataset plan; proceed with public records plus declared lab/synthetic fixtures when access is absent.
research_stewardship.timing: Before importing customer material or claiming real-customer evaluation.

research_stewardship.title: Can a data partnership support a viable commercial package?
research_stewardship.context: A data revenue idea is a business hypothesis; public access or an API subscription does not establish redistribution rights. Shams retains business partnership stewardship; Amr supplies D01/D17/D18 source and rights evidence.
questions: What proprietary enrichment would a partner supply, to whom and under what contract?
Can we display, cache, redistribute, bundle or resell it in cloud and disconnected installations?
What costs, attribution, renewal, withdrawal and customer-data restrictions would apply?
Would a complete-solution package create enough customer value to cover acquisition and support costs?
research_stewardship.closeWith: A BMC/value hypothesis plus rights/cost/partnership comparison; unresolved rights stay explicitly unknown and unbundled.
research_stewardship.timing: Before selling or bundling third-party data.

unresolved: Confirm practical reviewer availability and effort estimates with the team; package counts alone do not establish balanced effort.
Customer/business research remains OQ03/OQ05/OQ08 stewardship. No new commercial deliverable or customer access is assumed.
credit_rule: Primary accountability changes from 6 November onward. Earlier artifacts and contributions retain their actual authors; historical November 1/5 checkpoint plans are retained as dated history, not new deadlines.

asset_research.method: For every decision, record the official source URL, publisher/version or revision, access date, relevant section, claim, applicable asset/profile, evidence kind (documentation, measured lab result or labelled fixture), limitation and downstream decision. Compare viable alternatives or document why a second option is unavailable. Do not count links as evidence of correctness; keep unknowns, conflicting evidence and negative results visible. Never label a proposed test as executed.

What minimum OS/package/firmware identity does each supported consumer need, and what raw evidence can be retained without secrets?
